g.text: signs the vault and the mint

svg.text: his equity, less the liquidator’s fee
1% of the 5,000 notional, capped at equity
at or under the 250 maintenance margin
anyone may call liquidate_position(): the health
check is the only permission that matters, and Dave
is paid to be the one who shows up. A position that
gaps straight through zero pays him nothing, and
then nobody comes: production venues fund the
liquidator from an insurance fund for exactly that
